levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more situations has no plausible record category matched to it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every situation has at least one plausible category matched.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The two trickiest-situation explanations show genuine reasoning about ambiguity, not just a guess.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more matches are stated as certain fact rather than something to verify.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every match is explicitly framed as needing verification against a current local/official source.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection response shows genuine understanding of why rules vary by place and time, not just repeating the instruction.

lookFors: Every situation has at least one matched category with an explicit verify-locally note attached.
No specific real institution's actual requirement is asserted as fact anywhere.
The reflection response explains the reasoning, not just restates the rule.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
